# ==========================================================================
# Control/descriptor over NoC — Network-3 streaming connections (AUTO-GENERATED by write_hdl).
# Moves the per-vFPGA SQ/CQ + notify meta streams (the credit/descriptor loop)
# off fabric SLLs onto the hardened NoC. Mirrors host_noc_conn.xdc exactly: two
# DIAGONAL hub-shared fabrics, source-i always targets vFPGA i (group g pairs
# only with hub g):
#   ch2c (shell->wrapper, {host_sq,bpss_rd_cq,bpss_wr_cq}):
#        inst_cnoc_h2c_nmu_g (SLR0) -> NoC -> inst_cnoc_h2c_nsu_g (SLR1/2)
#   cc2h (wrapper->shell, {notify,bpss_rd_sq,bpss_wr_sq}):
#        inst_cnoc_c2h_nmu_g (SLR1/2) -> NoC -> inst_cnoc_c2h_nsu_g (SLR0)
# tdest = vFPGA id; each hub NSU carries its group's tdest RANGE. The 3 meta
# streams per direction are multiplexed (2-bit channel tag) into one 512b flit
# by axis_meta_pack/axis_meta_unpack, so the NoC sees a single stream per vFPGA.
#
# TILE PLACEMENT — DISJOINT from host_noc_conn (SLR0 {X2Y2,X3Y2,X2Y4,X3Y4},
# vFPGA {X0Y9,X1Y9,X2Y14,X3Y14}) and from the P2P endpoints (NMU Y8/Y13,
# NSU Y12/Y17). All coords exist on xcv80 (grid X0-3 x Y0-18). SLR0 = Y0-6,
# SLR1 = Y7-12, SLR2 = Y13-18; group g0,g1 -> SLR1, g2,g3 -> SLR2 (matches the
# mesh vFPGA->SLR split). Host-side columns X2/X3 are clear of CPM5 (X0/X1).
#   host-side (SLR0): X2Y1, X3Y1, X2Y3, X3Y3
#   vFPGA-side      : X2Y9, X3Y9 (SLR1), X0Y14, X1Y14 (SLR2)
# RISK: SLR0 tiles must not collide with CPM5/PS9/shell-NoC usage in the real
# static — validate_noc (flow_dyn_versal / cr_shell) is the gate.
# ==========================================================================
{% if cnfg.fdev == 'v80' and cnfg.en_host_noc == 1 and cnfg.n_reg > 1 %}
{% set M  = [cnfg.n_reg, 4] | min %}
{% set K  = (cnfg.n_reg + M - 1) // M %}
{% set ch2c_nmu_loc = ['NOC_NMU512_X2Y1','NOC_NMU512_X3Y1','NOC_NMU512_X2Y3','NOC_NMU512_X3Y3'] %}
{% set ch2c_nsu_loc = ['NOC_NSU512_X2Y9','NOC_NSU512_X3Y9','NOC_NSU512_X0Y14','NOC_NSU512_X1Y14'] %}
{% set cc2h_nmu_loc = ['NOC_NMU512_X2Y9','NOC_NMU512_X3Y9','NOC_NMU512_X0Y14','NOC_NMU512_X1Y14'] %}
{% set cc2h_nsu_loc = ['NOC_NSU512_X2Y1','NOC_NSU512_X3Y1','NOC_NSU512_X2Y3','NOC_NSU512_X3Y3'] %}
# ---- ctrl-h2c: host-side NMU (SLR0) -> vFPGA-side NSU (SLR1/2), diagonal g->g ----
{% for g in range(M) %}
set cnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_cnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/S_AXIS_nmu]
set_property LOCATION {{ ch2c_nmu_loc[g] }} $cnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ g }}
set cnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_cnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/M_AXIS_nsu]
set_property TDEST_ID {{ '0x%X' % (g * K) }}:{{ '0x%X' % ([g * K + K - 1, cnfg.n_reg - 1] | min) }} $cnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }}
set_property LOCATION {{ ch2c_nsu_loc[g] }} $cnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }}
create_noc_connection -source $cnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ g }} -target $cnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }}
{% endfor %}
# ---- ctrl-c2h: vFPGA-side NMU (SLR1/2) -> host-side NSU (SLR0), diagonal g->g ----
{% for g in range(M) %}
set cnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_cnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/S_AXIS_nmu]
set_property LOCATION {{ cc2h_nmu_loc[g] }} $cnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ g }}
set cnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_cnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/M_AXIS_nsu]
set_property TDEST_ID {{ '0x%X' % (g * K) }}:{{ '0x%X' % ([g * K + K - 1, cnfg.n_reg - 1] | min) }} $cnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }}
set_property LOCATION {{ cc2h_nsu_loc[g] }} $cnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }}
create_noc_connection -source $cnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ g }} -target $cnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}
